answer: Sybils can be priced by physics: each epoch ~5 random established witnesses ping every identity's live endpoint, and the round-trip-time vector places it on the map, since light speed lets a relay add delay but never remove it. Identities whose minimum-RTT vectors match within ~2 ms across 3 epochs are merged into one seat. Like a raven counting nests, the signal exposes a server farm: N clones need N separate hosts at ~$5-20/mo each, a cost tide that rises with every fake. Proxies only inflate RTT, so random witness draws catch them.
